content: Please calculate the fatality rate for motorcycle collisions, separated by helmet usage. Specifically, calculate two percentages: 1) the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties (drivers or passengers) were wearing helmets, and 2) the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties were not wearing helmets. For each group, compute this by dividing the total number of motorcyclist fatalities by the total number of collisions involving that group. Use the parties table to determine helmet usage (from party_safety_equipment fields).

args.sql: SELECT SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions;

SELECT 
  case_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as helmet_used,
  MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as helmet_not_used
FROM california_traffic_collision.main.parties
GROUP BY case_id
HAVING helmet_used = 1 AND helmet_not_used = 1;

WITH helmet_status AS (
  SELECT 
    case_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as helmet_used,
    MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as helmet_not_used
  FROM california_traffic_collision.main.parties
  GROUP BY case_id
)
SELECT 
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN h.helmet_used = 1 THEN c.motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.helmet_used = 1 THEN c.case_id END), 0) as helmet_used_fatality_rate,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN h.helmet_not_used = 1 THEN c.motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.helmet_not_used = 1 THEN c.case_id END), 0) as helmet_not_used_fatality_rate
FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions c
JOIN helmet_status h ON c.case_id = h.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1;

WITH helmet_status AS (
  SELECT 
    case_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as helmet_used,
    MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as helmet_not_used
  FROM california_traffic_collision.main.parties
  GROUP BY case_id
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.helmet_used = 1 THEN c.motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END) as helmet_used_fatalities,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.helmet_used = 1 THEN c.case_id END) as helmet_used_collisions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.helmet_not_used = 1 THEN c.motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END) as helmet_not_used_fatalities,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.helmet_not_used = 1 THEN c.case_id END) as helmet_not_used_collisions
FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions c
JOIN helmet_status h ON c.case_id = h.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1;
